_note: One home category per specialty. This is what makes /explore/{city}/{category}/{specialty}/ a single canonical address: 79 of 90 specialties appear under several categories in the listing data, so without a home each would generate a page per combination. Seeded from the most common top-level category among the listings carrying each term; ties and thin evidence were called by hand and are recorded in _why. A specialty with no home has no page. Categories are always the TOP-LEVEL term: the practice taxonomy is three deep (walks-lookouts < nature < experiences) but URLs stay flat. A home is only valid if the facet actually resolves under it with listings -- tallies alone put two specialties under categories whose page would have 404'd.

_why.aromatherapy: override: bodywork 3 / beauty 2 / spa 2 — spa is where people browse for it
_why.chakra-balancing: override: spa 2 / energy 2 — chakra work is energy, not a spa treatment
_why.consciousness-coaching: no listings yet — home named in advance
_why.fertility-support: override: nutrition 2 / family 2 / natural 2 — three-way tie; family matches the search
_why.forest-bathing: override: mind 1 / experiences 1 — it is an outing; nature already sits under experiences
_why.pranic-healing: override: 1/1/1 across mind, energy, yoga — pranic healing is energy work
_why.pregnancy-yoga: override: family 3 / yoga 3 — it is a yoga style, and that is what people search
_why.shiatsu: no listings yet — home named in advance
_why.sleep-coaching: override: spa 2 / mind 1 — coaching is behavioural, not a spa service
_why.steam-room: no listings yet — home named in advance
_why.surf-therapy: no listings yet — home named in advance
_why.womens-circles: override: community held the tally but zero resolve under it; experiences is where the page exists

_slugs_note: Where the address under the home category is not the specialty's own slug. The intent registry claims a shorter one for these three. Precomputed because working it out at render time meant calling the facet resolver once per link -- 227 queries each, and a page carries dozens.
